title: Free-T3–free-T4 coupling does not establish incremental resting-pulse prediction across NHANES cycles
abstract: Adding a log-freeT3 × log-freeT4 interaction to flexible individual-hormone and conventional predictors did not establish improved resting-pulse prediction in exploratory NHANES2007–2008 to2009–2010 transfer (4,580 source and1,703 target adults): weighted MSE difference 0.234506 bpm² (0.182% worse), jointPSU-bootstrap95% interval [-1.841191,1.922932].
